The '''Intellex III''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]]<ref name="CSWE" /> produced by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="History" /> The Intellex III was installed in [[R1-series astromech droid/Legends|R1-series astromech droids]] and [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4-series agromech droids]].<ref name="CSWE" />

It was a powerful unit,<ref name="CSWE" /> capable of handling integration with [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and [[Capital ship/Legends|capital]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. The internal memory had information on five hundred [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designs and an operating speed of 10,000 MPF. The unit also included [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] capabilities allowing the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to calculate a single [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump in an unprecedented amount of time.<ref name="History" /> The Intellex III was also able to handle both [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and [[Corporate Sector Standard]] transmission modes.<ref name="GG7">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref> However, the unit lacked the versatility of its successor, the [[Intellex IV/Legends|Intellex IV]].<ref name="CSWE" />
